concepts.name: provider
concepts.meaning: An actor who develops and supplies the AI system under its own name.

concepts.name: intended-purpose
concepts.meaning: The use, context and conditions specified for a system by its provider.

concepts.name: instructions-for-use
concepts.meaning: Information supplied to deployers for the intended and proper use of a system.

concepts.name: candidate-evaluation-use
concepts.meaning: The use of a system to evaluate candidates during recruitment and selection.

relationship.name: provider-issues-instructions
relationship.meaning: A provider supplies instructions for the use of the system.
